note: The prop kit of the set builder. footprint: the radius in metres (at scale 1) of the ground the prop takes, so a mark or a walk should stay outside it (the lint of CTS-21 follow-ups and the builder's own warning read it). colours: the keys a set may override in a prop's `colours`. Heights are not listed: a cloud floats, a flower patch is flat. HUB-31 road and rail kit (data first; the builders are CTS-33): road and track are built along a path of the set (`path`), so they take no ground; a crossing sits where a road path meets a track path and vehicles pass through it (footprint 0); a path's strip (half its width) must clear every other footprint (lint E_PATH_BLOCKED).
